title: The pull-bys carry it
assumes: A2 ends with two pull-bys — the robins by the right and number two by the left — and a pull-by is a dancer walking past another one to somewhere else: that is where the three places are taken, and the rest of the dance is danced from there.
quotes: A2  (8) Ladies chain to partner  (4) Women balance (RH)  (2) Women pull by right  (2) N2 neighbor pull by left
notes: One clause, on the second pull-by, so the dance's whole triple shift lands at the end of A2 and B1's N3 and N4 are read from the new seating — which is the thing to watch.
